No entry offer

Viewers leave without a trace

Someone who watched your 12.7k-view reel but isn’t ready to book a call has nothing to opt into. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

No first purchase

Most of your audience can’t say yes

Most people learning from your reels aren’t ready for practitioner training yet. With nothing smaller to buy, they don’t buy anything.

Free calls only

Every curious follower costs you a call

Both doors on your Linktree are free calls, so your calendar has to do the filtering. There’s no step that shows you who is serious before they book.

No ads

Every lead depends on today’s post

All your demand comes from organic reach. A quiet week of posting means a quiet calendar, and there’s no way to turn spend into booked calls.

Anyone not ready for a call today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

Sound familiar?

You’ve done the practices. Something still doesn’t fit.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover together

Why one single somatic protocol was never going to fit you

What the female nervous system needs that most one-size-fits-all approaches leave out.

Growing capacity vs “regulating”

Why calming down isn’t the same as expanding what your system can hold, and how to start on the second.

How your body and your nervous system talk to each other through the month, and what to notice.

Meeting the parts of you that resist change

A gentle introduction to parts work, so the part of you that holds back stops feeling like the enemy.

What makes a high-impact practitioner

For coaches and practitioners: what lets you hold more for the people you work with.

Before you grab your seat

Is this for practitioners or for my own nervous system?

Both. Come for yourself, or come as a coach or practitioner who wants to work with more depth.

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

No. It’s an educational class. It isn’t therapy or medical care and doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

Why is it only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, learn, and decide afterwards whether you want to go deeper.

Video ad scripts

Talking to camera, filmed the way you already film your reels.

Script 1 · “Not just regulating”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’ve been told to just regulate your nervous system, listen to this.”

Body

“Regulating helps you get through a hard moment. Growing capacity is different. It changes how much your system can hold in the first place. Most of us were only ever taught the first one.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the difference live in my Female Nervous System Masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera at home, natural light, same setup as your recent reels.

Script 2 · “One protocol”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Please stop reducing the female nervous system to one single protocol.”

Body

“Your capacity isn’t the same every day of the month. A practice that works one week can feel wrong the next. That’s not you doing it wrong. It’s a sign you need an approach built around your body.”

CTA

“Come to my live masterclass and we’ll start there. $17, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: opens on an oxblood title card with the hook in cream serif, then cut to you talking.

Script 3 · “For practitioners”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What makes some practitioners so much more impactful than others?”

Body

“It’s rarely another technique. It’s their own capacity, and how well they understand the nervous system in front of them, especially the female one. That can be learned.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera outdoors by water or greenery, on-screen text “capacity” highlighted.
